modmenu.descriptionTranslation.combind: Plunder th' vanilla key binds with combo support.
combind.config.title: Combind Scrib o' th' Crew
combind.config.allowConflicts.tooltip: When disabled, pressin' a combo won't also trigger simpler bindings whose keys be contained within it. For example, pressin' Left Shift + E won't also trigger E.
combind.config.sequenceWindowMs.tooltip: How long after a key press th' next can still be counted as part o' th' sequence in-game.
combind.config.sequenceRecordingWindowMs: How long to wait fer th' next press before sealing a sequence in th' Knob orders screen.
